name: Medicreations
old_description: Uncompromising results. Empowering your growth — without sacrificing value.
about:
Medicreations is based in Las Vegas, Nevada. The company was founded after decades of combined experience in medical aesthetics and engineering, when its creators recognized that practitioners struggled with lackluster service and manufacturers who refused to honor warranties. They set out to build premium-quality, USA-made aesthetic devices backed by a two-year warranty and expert support.

The company designs and manufactures a line of energy-based aesthetic systems, including the MediSpa (a seven-in-one facial platform), the Velo CO2 laser, the MediDiode diode laser for hair removal, the MediYag Q-switched Nd:YAG laser for pigmentation and tattoo removal, and the MediLight IPL system. All devices are produced in an FDA-audited, ISO-certified facility in Las Vegas.

Medicreations serves medical aesthetics practices, medspas, and clinics nationwide. Its technologies power treatments such as skin rejuvenation, acne therapy, anti-aging, pigmentation correction, scar revision, tattoo removal, and hair removal for all skin types.

The company differentiates itself with a two-year industry-leading warranty, included training and ongoing support, minimal maintenance requirements, and limited consumables. It emphasizes fast treatment times, natural-looking results, and durable, USA-made construction.
